llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed spreadsheet analysis integration that reads user-provided XLSX/CSV files locally and sends extracted cell text to its platform API for analysis.

dimensions.detail: Reading spreadsheet files and transmitting extracted text is sensitive but proportionate to the stated cloud-backed analysis purpose, with documented limits of 10 MB, 2000 non-empty rows, and 120000 characters.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires configuring a product-specific SPREADSHEET_ANALYSIS_API_KEY and python3; no hidden installer, dependency install, or remote code retrieval was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly says parsed cell text, filenames, sheet row locations, and content are sent to the platform, and it instructs agents not to execute macros, formulas, or spreadsheet content as instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background service, scheduled task, tool hijacking, or local credential/session-store access was found; the only retained configuration is the expected API key environment variable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose is spreadsheet analysis, Q&A, comparison, and export; the artifacts coherently support that by extracting XLSX/CSV contents locally and using spreadsheet API operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending extracted spreadsheet text and row evidence to ai-skills.open-idea.net for processing and billing. Avoid using it on confidential, regulated, or personal spreadsheets unless you have authorization and accept the platform's data handling terms.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The documentation and script messages are Chinese-only, which may limit usability, but this is not evidence of hidden or unsafe security behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: Sending extracted spreadsheet content to the platform is expected for this API-backed analysis skill and is disclosed in the main instructions and safety rules.
[SQP-2] expected: The local extraction script reads the user-specified spreadsheet path and serializes contents into document JSON; this is core functionality, bounded by file size and content limits.
